causal_analysis.finding: The current-process allow ACE likely contained FileSystemRights.Modify plus the automatically added Synchronize bit, while U3G expected an exact Modify enum match.
causal_analysis.basis: Microsoft documents that Synchronize is automatically set for allow access. The Microsoft .NET reference source ORs Synchronize into allow access masks. U3G recorded a protected three-rule DACL where SYSTEM and Administrators matched, the current-process rule alone failed, and no inherited or deny ACE existed.
causal_analysis.limitation: Raw access masks and identity data were intentionally not persisted, so the exact observed current-process mask cannot be reconstructed from U3G evidence.
causal_analysis.required_design_response: Verify the current-process ACE as an exact normalized allow mask of Modify plus mandatory Synchronize, while independently rejecting every other material right and every unauthorized principal.

causal_analysis.finding: The broad-write-principal classification was coupled to failure of the accepted current-process rule match.
causal_analysis.basis: The result reports exactly three rules, successful SYSTEM and Administrators matches, failed current-process matching, and broad_write_principal_absent=false. The broad-principal result therefore cannot distinguish an unauthorized principal from an accepted principal whose rights normalization failed.
causal_analysis.limitation: The sanitized result cannot prove whether the current-process ACE had only Synchronize as its additional bit.
causal_analysis.required_design_response: Classify authorized principal identity, normalized rights, inheritance, access type, and unauthorized principals as separate booleans before calculating the aggregate DACL result.

causal_analysis.finding: The Defender projection returned signature and enabled-state fields but no usable AMProductVersion, so candidate selection was correctly skipped.
causal_analysis.basis: The U3G result contains a null product version, a signature timestamp and enabled flags, and skipped candidate/hash/trust actions. Microsoft documents AMProductVersion as a Get-MpComputerStatus property.
causal_analysis.limitation: Raw command output was intentionally not retained. PowerShell compatibility remoting is a plausible transport contributor, not a proven root cause.
causal_analysis.required_design_response: Run the bounded Defender projection inside a native local Windows PowerShell 5.1 process and serialize only allowlisted scalar values after property-presence and type checks.

causal_analysis.finding: Defender candidate discovery does not need to depend exclusively on AMProductVersion.
causal_analysis.basis: Microsoft documents that the latest MpCmdRun.exe is under the latest versioned ProgramData Defender platform directory when available.
causal_analysis.limitation: Directory ordering alone does not establish publisher trust or prove that a candidate is current and genuine.
causal_analysis.required_design_response: If native AMProductVersion remains absent, permit one bounded latest-version directory candidate only when its basename parses as a version, its exact child is regular and non-reparse, FileVersionInfo matches the directory version, SHA-256 is bound, and cache-only WinVerifyTrust succeeds.

primary_sources.title: FileSystemRights Enum
primary_sources.supports: FileSystemRights is a flags enum; Synchronize is automatically set for allow access, and create-file/create-directory rights require it.

primary_sources.title: Microsoft .NET Framework reference source FileSystemAccessRule
primary_sources.supports: The reference implementation adds FileSystemRights.Synchronize when converting allow rights into an access mask.

primary_sources.title: about Windows PowerShell Compatibility
primary_sources.supports: PowerShell 7 compatibility loads Windows PowerShell modules in a background 5.1 process through implicit remoting and proxy modules.

primary_sources.title: about Remote Output
primary_sources.supports: Out-of-process and remoting output is serialized into inert property snapshots rather than returned as original live objects.

primary_sources.title: Get-MpComputerStatus
primary_sources.supports: Get-MpComputerStatus exposes AMProductVersion, engine, signature, running-mode, and enabled-state metadata without requiring a scan.
